findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data

findings.title: Add Cost of Care % of Revenue
findings.detail: Cost of Care has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Cost of Care % of Revenue" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.title: Patient Care Revenue (care days × daily rate) moved EUR -18M vs Budget
